gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Tilt Neon draws every letter like glowing tubing, one gauge throughout, with a splayed c terminal. Noto Sans Bengali answers with open-mouthed letters and capitals barely taller than lowercase, so it feels like the plain sans doing the quiet work.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Tilt Neon has the bold look of a ring-shaped o with a constant wall, and a large x-height under short ascenders. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki follows with tightly coiled, rope-like lowercase and open apertures, a plain sans that hands the shouting back.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Contemporary and neutral, Noto Sans Brahmi keeps its mean line high and leaves every curve open at the end. Noto Sans Brahmi is the plain sans for taking in text, while Tilt Neon stitches thread-like strokes into a loud, commanding heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Modern in feel, Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous gaps between curve ends and stems under a high-set x-height. Tilt Neon above it holds an unvarying line thickness, so enlarging the plain sans body would only crowd that bold heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-carian: Clean and professional, Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades. And Tilt Neon brings the bold punch of a plain unmodulated outline, the single quality that makes this sans partner stand out.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Tilt Neon bends its tubing into bold letters, the same gauge throughout. Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the caps with uncrowded s and c mouths, so a slightly larger size for this sans-serif suits it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-cham: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Cham shows tall rounded lowercase forms with plenty of entry space on its c. Noto Sans Cham sits next to Tilt Neon, whose sign-painter's-stencil flatness of line makes the whole pairing feel both loud and friendly.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Tilt Neon commands with a ruler-straight line weight and big, bold lowercase. Noto Sans Cherokee handles the reading, with a tall band of letters under short stalks and an e whose terminal gapes wide, a friendly sans-serif.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Tilt Neon presses twine-like strokes flat, bold and commanding. Noto Sans Chorasmian takes over below with curves that stop short instead of closing in, so the heading grabs attention and the plain sans body carries the text.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-coptic: That splayed c terminal, on tube-like letters of one width, is Tilt Neon's calling card. Noto Sans Coptic sits below as a plain sans with a dominant middle zone and open s and c mouths, giving the heading room to boom.
